title: 第一卷 第10章 收集分家证据
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

沈鹿溪没想到，事情来得这么快。

她从柳家村回来的当天傍晚，刚一进院子，就见到正房堂屋里坐了个生人。

看身形是个四十来岁的妇人，穿着靛蓝色的褂子，头上插了根簪子，手里拿了条帕子，笑得满脸褶子。

沈鹿溪一眼就认出来了。

张媒婆。

镇上专门给人说亲的张媒婆。

前世就是这个女人上的门，笑嘻嘻的跟王桂花谈好了价格，二十两银子，把她卖给了周员外当小妾。

沈鹿溪想到这，火气上来了一瞬，又压了下去，随即脚步恢复正常，不急不慢的往自家小屋里头走。

经过正房的时候，她竖着耳朵听了几句。

“......王婶子，您家这个孙女我可是见过的，模样周正，手脚勤快，配周员外都绰绰有余了......”

“......周老爷可是镇上有头有脸的人物，家里田产铺子都有，您孙女嫁过去就是享福去了......”

王桂花声音压得很低，听不太清，隐约能听到“多少银子”“什么时候”之类的字眼。

赵翠屏也在里头，时不时插一句嘴，语气里掩不住的兴奋。

沈鹿溪站在自家门口，面上没什么表情。

这么快就来了，这次比前世早了好几个月。

前世是秋天才来的，这辈子不知道为何提前了。

想来大概是，赵翠屏为了给沈金宝凑赌债，主动去找了周员外，把卖人的事提前张罗了起来。

沈鹿溪走进屋里，把门带上。

柳荞娘正在屋里搓麻绳，听见外头的说笑声，脸色有些不安：“鹿溪，正房那边来了个媒婆，你说是不是......”

“娘，我知道。”

柳荞娘手上的活停了，麻绳垂下来，搭在膝盖上，声音发紧：“她们该不会是要把你......”

“娘你别慌。”沈鹿溪在炕沿上坐了下来，“她们想卖我，那也得我答应才行。这事我已经有准备了，你别出去，也别跟他们吵。”

柳荞娘攥着麻绳，指节都捏白了。

沈鹿溪拍了拍她的手：“信我。”

柳荞娘看着女儿的眼睛，那里头没有害怕，稳稳当当的。

她深吸了一口气，点了点头。

沈鹿溪在屋里头坐着，重新规划起来。

本来打算过一阵子再动手，但眼下时间等不及了。

张媒婆今天来探口风，王桂花要是点了头，估计过不了多久就会签卖身契。

至于证据，现在大概是够的。

田产文书的抄件有了，赵翠萍虐待柳荞娘和沈小满的事，村里的李婶子和孙婶子都亲眼见过，可以作证，沈金宝赌钱的事，镇上赌坊的伙计也能证实。

Page (1/3)

Shen Luxi didn't expect that things would happen so quickly.

In the evening when she returned from Liujiacun, as soon as she entered the courtyard, she saw a stranger sitting in the main hall.

She looked like a woman in her forties, wearing an indigo gown, a hairpin in her hair, a handkerchief in her hand, and a smile all over her face.

Shen Luxi recognized it at a glance.

Matchmaker Zhang.

Zhang, the matchmaker in town who specializes in proposing marriages to people.

In the previous life, this woman came to the door. She negotiated a price with Wang Guihua with a smile, and sold her to Zhou Yuanwai as a concubine for twenty taels of silver.

Thinking of this, Shen Luxi became angry for a moment, then suppressed it. Then her steps returned to normal and she walked slowly and unhurriedly into her hut.

As she passed the main room, she listened carefully to a few words.

"...Aunt Wang, I have seen this granddaughter of yours before. She has an upright appearance and is diligent in her hands and feet. She is more than capable of serving as a coroner..."

"...Mr. Zhou is a well-known figure in the town. He has a farm and shop at home. Your granddaughter will be blessed if she gets married..."

Wang Guihua's voice was very low and she couldn't hear clearly. She could vaguely hear words like "how much money" and "when".

Zhao Cuiping was also there, interjecting from time to time with excitement in his tone.

Shen Luxi stood at the door of his house with no expression on his face.

It came so quickly, this time several months earlier than in the previous life.

In my previous life, it came in autumn, but I don’t know why it came earlier in this life.

It seems that Zhao Cuiping took the initiative to find Zhou Yuanwai and arranged the sale in advance in order to collect Shen Jinbao's gambling debt.

Shen Luxi walked into the house and closed the door.

Liu Qiao Niang was twisting hemp rope in the house. When she heard the chatter and laughter outside, she looked a little uneasy: "Lu Xi, there is a matchmaker in the main room. Do you think..."

"Mom, I know."

Liu Qiaoniang stopped working, the hemp rope hung down, and was placed on her knees. Her voice was tight: "Could they be trying to get you..."

"Mom, don't panic." Shen Luxi sat down on the edge of the Kang, "If they want to sell me, I have to agree. I've already prepared for this. Don't go out and don't argue with them."

Liu Qiaoniang clutched the hemp rope until her knuckles turned white.

Shen Luxi patted her hand: "Trust me."

Liu Qiaoniang looked into her daughter's eyes. There was no fear in them, she was steady.

She took a deep breath and nodded.

Shen Luxi sat in the room and re-planned.

I originally planned to do it after a while, but now I can't wait.

Matchmaker Zhang came to talk to her today. If Wang Guihua nodded, she would probably sign a contract of sale in a short time.

As for the evidence, that's probably enough for now.

Copies of the property documents are available. Aunt Li and Aunt Sun in the village have witnessed Zhao Cuiping's abuse of Liu Qiaoniang and Shen Xiaoman and can testify. The gambling shop clerks in the town can also confirm Shen Jinbao's gambling.
